project._note: Copy to <project>/Creatives/<name>.json. char_ref needs a cropped model sheet beside it (CHAR_MASCOT_panels/ with front, profile, three_quarter, closeup .png - charsheet.py) or flow_fire.py refuses CHAR_NO_SHEET.
